caption:
You do not need a long speech when the answer is no. A short reason and a clear next step is enough.

Save this for the next time you need to disappoint someone kindly.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #feedback

slides.headline: Saying no to PTO
rows: “I can’t approve that week off. We won’t have coverage.”
“I’m so sorry, I hate doing this.”
“Let’s look at other dates that could work.”
“Maybe put it in anyway and we’ll see.”
“I know that’s frustrating. I wanted to tell you today.”
